daily_load_assessment: Immediate fatigue is practically non-existent (ATL: 6.6, TSB: +6.3) following 18 days of complete inactivity since your last session on Nov 2. You are fully rested physically, but your neuromuscular system and aerobic capacity are dormant.
acute_status_assessment_3_weeks: Acute training status is extremely low, with only 1 logged session (42 TSS, 7.8 km run) in the past 21 days. Fitness decay is significant. The immediate requirement for this 3-week window is re-establishing training consistency and rebuilding acute workload (ATL) safely.
sport_trend_assessment_6_months: Your 6-month sport trend shows a sharp decline from summer volume spikes down to a CTL of 12.9, leaving a wide gap to your goal CTL of 60. To bridge this gap safely, we need a disciplined ramp rate (+1 to +2 CTL/week) built around a 70/30 Pyramidal distribution.
coach_verdict: Priority 1 (Zone 2 Base Rebuild Cycling) is your top mandatory choice today. Coming off an 18-day layoff, starting with low-impact cycling allows you to accumulate substantial aerobic TSS and restart your CTL progression without risking running-induced tissue strain.

priority_1.workout_details: 10 min progressive warm-up to 150W; 65 min steady Zone 2 at 155-175W maintaining cadence between 85-95 RPM; 5 min cool-down spin. Total duration: 80 min.
priority_1.reason: Highest priority. Provides low-impact aerobic load to ignite your CTL ramp rate safely while protecting your joints after an 18-day break.

priority_2.workout_details: 10 min easy warm-up jog; 30 min steady Zone 2 run (Keep HR strictly below 150 bpm); 5x20-sec strides at 5km race pace with 40-sec walking recovery; 5 min walk cool-down. Total duration: 45 min.
priority_2.reason: Second priority. Reintroduces running mechanics and 5km neuromuscular speed without accumulating excessive impact fatigue.

priority_3.workout_details: Barbell Back Squats 4x8 (controlled tempo); Barbell Bench Press 4x8; Heavy Sandbag Clean & Carry 3x40m (70kg sandbag); Barbell Overhead Press 3x10; Hanging Leg Raises & Ab Wheel Rollouts 3x12.
priority_3.reason: Third priority. Strengthens cycling torque production, running durability, and upper body aesthetics without overtaxing your cardiovascular engine.
